comparison.objective: Wipe an entire monitor lead and its end pieces outward in one pass, then place it on a drape.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain sliding contact along a deformable cord, switch hand roles, and avoid backtracking or re-wiping.
comparison.success_condition: All cord marks and end-piece faces are wiped once, the lead lies on the drape, and forbidden reverse strokes never occur.
comparison.reason: Deformable one-way wiping and surface coverage do not overlap the candidate's threaded stop adjustment and retention test.
